title: How mizerShelf extends mizer
text: detritus spectrum always held fixed power-law shape; overall biomass BB dynamical. biomass satisfies dBdt=production−consumption⋅B+external\frac{dB}{dt} = \text{production} - \text{consumption} \cdot B + \text{external} : production comes unassimilated food (faeces), decomposing carrion, external input pelagic zone (getDetritusProduction()), consumption total rate species feed detritus (detritus_consumption()), proportional current biomass, external tunable constant represents sedimentation pelagic waters, stored other_params(params)$detritus$external. detritus_dynamics() solves ODE analytically within time step avoid instabilities simple Euler step: B(t+Δt)=B(t)e−cΔt+pc(1−e−cΔt)B(t + \Delta t) = B(t)\,e^{-c\,\Delta t} + \frac{p}{c}\left(1 - e^{-c\,\Delta t}\right) cc mass-specific consumption rate pp production rate. shape spectrum scaled new biomass: function receives n_pp (current resource spectrum), initial spectrum, update applied whatever state simulation currently .
code: detritus_dynamics <- function(params, n, n_pp, n_other, rates, dt, ...) {     current_biomass <- detritus_biomass(params, n_pp = n_pp)     consumption     <- detritus_consumption(params, n_pp, rates) / current_biomass     production      <- sum(getDetritusProduction(params, n, n_other, rates))     if (consumption) {         et           <- exp(-consumption * dt)         next_biomass <- current_biomass * et + production / consumption * (1 - et)     } else {         next_biomass <- current_biomass + production * dt     }     n_pp * next_biomass / current_biomass }

what: How the pieces fit together in newDetritusCarrionParams()
title: How mizerShelf extends mizer
text: four extension mechanisms wired inside single constructor: order matters. resource dynamics set inside newMultispeciesParams() mizer computes initial rates, detritus shape consistent start. carrion component registered species parameters set, rho can computed initial encounter rates. marker class applied last, standard mizer slots populated.
code: newDetritusCarrionParams <- function(species_params,                                      w_min_detritus = NA,                                      w_max_detritus = 1,                                      n = 0.7, ...) {     # 1. Detritus: override resource dynamics     params <- newMultispeciesParams(         species_params   = species_params,         min_w_pp         = w_min_detritus,         w_pp_cutoff      = w_max_detritus,         n = n, p = n,         resource_dynamics = "detritus_dynamics",         ...)      # Initialise rho so each species can reach feeding level f0 at max size     f0  <- set_species_param_default(params@species_params, "f0", 0.6)$f0     ic  <- set_species_param_default(                params@species_params, "interaction_carrion", 1)$interaction_carrion     E   <- getEncounter(params)[, length(params@w)] /                (params@w[length(params@w)] ^ n)     rho <- pmax(0, f0 * params@species_params$h / (1 - f0) - E) * ic     params@species_params$rho_carrion <- rho     rho <- outer(params@species_params$rho_carrion, params@w ^ n)      # 2. Mortality: custom rate function adds excess gear mortality     params <- setRateFunction(params, "Mort", "seMort")      # 3. Carrion: scalar dynamical component     params <- setComponent(         params, "carrion", initial_value = 1,         dynamics_fun     = "carrion_dynamics",         encounter_fun    = "encounter_contribution",         component_params = list(rho = rho))      # 4. Marker class: enables S3 dispatch for shelf-specific methods     params <- setColours(params,                          c(Detritus = "forestgreen", carrion = "peru"))      params@extensions <- getRegisteredExtensions()     params <- coerceToExtensionClass(params) }

title: How mizerShelf extends mizer
text: mizerShelf illustrates four core mizer extension mechanisms working together: Resource dynamics override — detritus reuses mizer’s resource spectrum infrastructure custom ODE tracks total biomass rescales spectrum shape. setRateFunction() — custom seMort() adds excess gear mortality standard mortality calculation single-line wrapper around mizerMort(). setComponent() — carrion scalar dynamical variable whose biomass evolves time step whose encounter-rate contribution automatically included getEncounter() getDiet(). S4 marker classes + S3 dispatch — mizerShelf mizerShelfSim ensure shelf-specific methods (getBiomass, tuneSteadyState, scaleModel, addSpecies, removeSpecies) dispatched automatically, every override delegates NextMethod() full mizer pipeline remains intact. Together, mechanisms allow mizerShelf add two ecologically important processes — benthic detritus carrion scavenging — mizer model without modifying mizer source code.
